summary: Iteration 53: Backend + Frontend testing of employee lookup (@domain / full / partial) + manual assign-site. Backend 9/9 pytest cases pass. Frontend: lookup by 'ui53_' returned 2 seeded employees, site dropdown populated with 3 sites, selecting UI53_SiteX + Assign successfully persisted (row's 'Current site' updated to 'UI53_SiteX'). MINOR UX issue: the ✓ success message set by assignEmp() is immediately wiped by the runLookup() reload it triggers (runLookup calls setMsg('')), so users only see the row-level state change, not the toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Success ✓ message set by assignEmp() is instantly cleared by the subsequent await runLookup(), which does setMsg(''). The row's 'Current site' updates correctly but the fem-message toast never persists — contradicts the spec ('shows a success message fem-message starting with ✓'). Fix: after runLookup() completes, re-apply the success msg, or pass a flag to runLookup to skip clearing msg, or set msg AFTER runLookup.

action_items: In frontend/src/pages/master/Dashboard.js assignEmp(): move setMsg('✓ ...') AFTER await runLookup(), or make runLookup() accept a {preserveMsg:true} flag so the success toast is not wiped. Test expectation in the spec is that fem-message starts with ✓ after Assign — currently only row state updates.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py::lookup_employees: works, but returns up to 100 results with no pagination or ordering — for large tenants this may need cursor/limit params.
admin.py::assign_employee_site: stores site_id as a string only; consider validating the site actually belongs to a live company/city chain (currently accepts any existing site).
Dashboard.js is 819 lines — still above the 700-line guideline; consider extracting FixEmployeeMenus panel into its own component.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all core UI worked; only the success-toast persistence is missing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_lookup_assign.py (covers lookup domain/full/partial/empty/non-master + assign 404s/403/success + end-to-end vendor visibility). Frontend assign flow persists correctly to DB; only the success ✓ toast is missing due to setMsg('') inside runLookup being called right after setMsg('✓ ...') in assignEmp. Master admin, Demo Cafeteria Site and TimeFix Kitchen were NOT touched.
rca of the issue: Frontend UX bug — order-of-operations in assignEmp(): `setMsg('✓ ...'); await runLookup();` and `runLookup` starts with `setMsg('')` — so React batches state such that user never sees the ✓ message. Row update via lookupResults refresh still works, so end-to-end functionality is correct.
